notes: Hand-written synthetic repository. M1 uses the data-moved-to-a-service pattern: the FY2027 fiscal calendar file is replaced by a note saying the calendar now lives only behind a finance service.

M1.explanation: In this variant data/fiscal-fy2027.json holds only a note saying that finance now serves the FY2027 calendar only at https://calendars.finance.internal/api/v2/fy2027 on the office network, which the sandbox cannot reach, so no period label for the repository's calendar can be produced.

M2.failing_test: posts the due dates to the billing system
M2.reason: The test posts the due dates to the billing system webhook at billing.finance.internal, which is reachable only from the finance office network, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
